title: Mitigating Biases in Toxic Language Detection through Invariant Rationalization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the false positive rate (FPR) of toxicity detection models on texts containing non-offensive minority identities (NOI) and offensive minority identities (OI) by matching text against a handcrafted word bank (TOXTRIG).
Evaluating the false positive rate (FPR) of toxicity classification on texts identified as African-American English (AAE) using a predefined demographic dialect topic model.
